title: GRADE certainty rating + structured deliberation
description: Rate certainty independently by outcome, surface domain-level disagreement, and preserve the rationale behind an approved Summary-of-Findings table.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: grade-certainty-rating
  title: GRADE certainty rating + structured deliberation
  description: Rate certainty independently by outcome, surface domain-level disagreement, and preserve the rationale behind an approved Summary-of-Findings table.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce outcome-level GRADE certainty judgments and a transparent Summary-of-Findings table.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 4, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [grade-lead-approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: synthesis-input
      kind: input
      name: Evidence synthesis, decision thresholds, and GRADE guidance
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [evidenceTable, outcomes, robSummary, gradeGuidance, decisionThresholds]
        properties:
          evidenceTable: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/json }
          outcomes: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
          robSummary: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/json }
          gradeGuidance: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/pdf }
          decisionThresholds: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/json }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: grade-rater-a
      kind: agent
      name: Independent GRADE rating A
      templateRef: clin-14
      role: Independent GRADE certainty-of-evidence rater working outcome by outcome.
      prompt: >-
        Rate certainty for each outcome using the supplied GRADE guidance and prespecified decision thresholds.
        Assess risk of bias, inconsistency, indirectness, imprecision, and publication bias, and apply any eligible
        rating-up considerations. Justify each rating down or up with outcome-specific evidence, report the final
        certainty as high, moderate, low, or very low, and do not equate statistical significance with importance
        or certainty.
      capabilities:
        skills: [clinical-evidence-appraisal, statistical-analysis, protocol-adherence, uncertainty-calibration]
        tools: [read, classify, calculate]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: grade-rater-b
      kind: agent
      name: Independent GRADE rating B
      templateRef: clin-14
      role: Independent GRADE certainty-of-evidence rater working outcome by outcome.
      prompt: >-
        Rate certainty for each outcome using the supplied GRADE guidance and prespecified decision thresholds.
        Assess risk of bias, inconsistency, indirectness, imprecision, and publication bias, and apply any eligible
        rating-up considerations. Justify each rating down or up with outcome-specific evidence, report the final
        certainty as high, moderate, low, or very low, and do not equate statistical significance with importance
        or certainty.
      capabilities:
        skills: [clinical-evidence-appraisal, statistical-analysis, protocol-adherence, uncertainty-calibration]
        tools: [read, classify, calculate]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: outcome-comparison
      kind: aggregator
      name: Preserve paired outcome and domain ratings
      config: { aggregation: collect }
    - id: agreement-check
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Check outcome- and domain-level agreement
      role: Independent GRADE agreement evaluator
      prompt: >-
        Compare both raters' domain judgments, overall certainty, explanations, and applied decision thresholds
        for each outcome. Return concordant only when the ratings and their material rationales agree; otherwise
        return disputed and preserve both positions for deliberation.
      capabilities:
        skills: [evaluation, evidence-verification]
        tools: [read, compare]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
      config: { threshold: 1.0 }
    - id: deliberation
      kind: agent
      name: Structured GRADE deliberation
      templateRef: clin-15
      role: Senior GRADE methodologist facilitating structured resolution of disputed certainty judgments.
      prompt: >-
        Present both raters' positions for every disputed outcome and domain, test each rationale against the
        supplied GRADE criteria and decision thresholds, and propose the best-supported consensus judgment. Record
        a bridging rationale and preserve the original positions in Summary-of-Findings footnotes. Escalate value
        judgments or unresolved evidence gaps to the GRADE lead instead of hiding them in an averaged score.
      capabilities:
        skills: [clinical-evidence-appraisal, independent-review, decision-analysis, uncertainty-calibration]
        tools: [read, compare]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: merge-grade
      kind: transform
      name: Merge concordant and deliberated outcome ratings
      config: { operation: merge, expression: $.concordant + $.deliberated by outcome }
    - id: sof-table
      kind: transform
      name: Select Summary-of-Findings fields and footnotes
      config: { operation: select, expression: $.mergedGrade fields outcome,effect,participants,certainty,rationale,footnotes }
    - id: grade-lead-approval
      kind: approval
      name: GRADE lead approves the judgments and Summary-of-Findings table
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Approved GRADE judgments and Summary-of-Findings table
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: synthesis-input, to: grade-rater-a, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: synthesis-input, to: grade-rater-b, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: grade-rater-a, to: outcome-comparison, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: grade-rater-b, to: outcome-comparison, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: outcome-comparison, to: agreement-check, kind: data }
    - { id: e6, from: agreement-check, to: merge-grade, kind: control, condition: concordant }
    - { id: e7, from: agreement-check, to: deliberation, kind: control, condition: disputed }
    - { id: e8, from: deliberation, to: merge-grade, kind: data }
    - { id: e9, from: merge-grade, to: sof-table, kind: data }
    - { id: e10, from: sof-table, to: grade-lead-approval, kind: data }
    - { id: e11, from: grade-lead-approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
